verdict.rationale: The evidence implies Raygun ships official client libraries: a community user praises its .NET and WinRT support, the docs have a JavaScript language guide, and errors can be filtered before they are sent from your application, which implies a client-side library. None of the evidence explicitly names or documents official SDKs, their language coverage, or their APIs. missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation, a list of supported languages and platforms, SDK API reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
